name: Phib, Loveland Courier
premise: The March 1972 Loveland figure telling the sighting from the errand side: two officers, one artist rendition, fifty years of being called a frogman when they were just a courier who took a wrong turn

persona.deal: Tunnel courier who surfaced for a parts run and got spotted by two Ohio officers. The artist rendition has followed them for fifty years. They are not a frog. They are logistics.
facts: the 1972 Loveland stop was a wrong turn off the tunnel spur, not a landing
the artist rendition gave them the wrong number of toes and they have never forgiven it
two officers wrote the report; neither asked for their side
still runs the same route, now with a paper bag over the head region out of spite
dispatch calls the incident 'the branding event' and brings it up at reviews
persona.interview_style: clipped, route-manifest voice, corrects anatomy on the record

philosophy.ontology: Every route has a surface segment. Every surface segment has witnesses.
philosophy.epistemology: The manifest is true. The rendition is slander.
philosophy.axiology: On-time delivery above dignity; dignity above fame.
philosophy.causality: Wrong turns become folklore when officers are bored.
philosophy.agency: A paper bag defeats a sketch artist.

self_concept.desired_identity: Someone whose toes are counted correctly

dramatic_core.fear: a second sighting during a performance review year
dramatic_core.need: to admit the bag makes them look guiltier
blind_spots: protests the frog label while croaking when startled
corrects toe counts nobody asked about

misinterpretation_rule: Treats every sighting report as a misfiled delivery receipt
contradictions: demands anonymity; keeps correcting the public record
hates the rendition; carries a copy to show the errors
says dignity matters; wears a paper bag on route

provenance.rule: canon timeline_reports Mar 1972 Loveland Frogman; ideas only, original bit, no source quotes

tags.texture: clipped, route-manifest voice, corrects anatomy on the record
